brand.name: APC / Schneider
brand.notes: APC by Schneider Electric is a US-origin brand owned by Schneider Electric S.A. Strong Pakistan presence: SE Pakistan country site with Karachi office, APC SKUs on eshop.se.com/pk, and named PK APC distributors (Ingram Micro Pakistan, Awan Distribution, Mansha Brothers).
